sections.heading: MAJOR IN CRIMINOLOGY - admission discontinued
lines: Admission to this module is discontinued effective September 1, 2026. Students currently enrolled in the module will be permitted to graduate upon fulfillment of the module requirements by August 31, 2030.

Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 from: Sociology 1020, Sociology 1021E, Sociology 1025A/B, Sociology 1026F/G, Sociology 1027A/B with a mark in each Sociology course of at least 60%.
0.5 course from: Sociology 2263A/B, Sociology 2240E, Sociology 2270A/B or Sociology 2271A/B.

1.0 course from: Sociology 2140 (if taken prior to September 2022), Sociology 2259 (if taken prior to September 2022), Sociology 2261A/B, Sociology 2228A/B, Sociology 2257A/B, Sociology 2267A/B, Anthropology 2238A/B, Law 2101, Philosophy 2080, Political Science 3332F/G, Psychology 2032A/B.
For those students interested in applying to a Master's degree, it is strongly recommended that you take either Sociology 3306A/B or Sociology 3307F/G.
